scope: Personal selfie reference library; index of existing files, separate from canonical OE avatar state.
owner_direction: Fresh looks every week. Build imagegen variations of clothing, setting, framing and angles; retain useful references for future use. The library grows instead of restricting weekly production to two repeated outfits.

entries.label: Office / stone knit polo / near frontal forward lean

new_angle_policy: Generated angles can be cataloged as untested concepts. Still-image selection does not establish moving likeness; the rejected v11 motion test remains rejected. Promote a new angle only after the owner accepts a short moving test.
storage: Full image files remain in their original local media paths. Index binds source paths and SHA256; no images regenerated in this turn.
